examples.text: He put on a clean white <w>singlet</w> before heading out into the hot summer sun.

examples.text: The wrestler adjusted his <w>singlet</w> before stepping onto the mat for the final match.

senses.sense_definition: A person who has a single personality and occupies one human body, as opposed to someone with multiple personalities.

examples.text: Many people identify as a <w>singlet</w> because they experience their consciousness as a single, unified self.
It is important for a <w>singlet</w> to respect the diverse experiences of those who are plural.

senses.sense_definition: A quantum state characterized by having zero total spin.

examples.text: The molecule transitions from an excited state back to the ground <w>singlet</w> state.

senses.sense_definition: A single item or a spectroscopic peak that stands alone.

examples.text: The NMR spectrum showed a sharp <w>singlet</w> indicating a specific chemical environment.
